#summary Chair filesystem layout and Dependencies of packages
#labels Deprecated,Phase-Design

= Filesystem Layout: =

Library is done *as plain as it is possible*.

/chair/package/ - that is where package located.

For autoload package location is /chair/autoload/

For context package location is /chair/context/ and so on..

= Dependencies: =

All packages have 2 stable dependencies:

  * autoload package
  * context package

Other package dependencies should be mentioned inside package description.
